prose.subject: Invoice INV-65486 from Marlow Print
prose.body:
Dear Fallowfield Games Team,

Please find below the details for our monthly services provided during this billing cycle. We appreciate your continued partnership.

**Invoice Number:** INV-65486
**From:** Marlow Print (marlow-print.example)
**To:** Fallowfield Games
**Total Amount Due:** 230.32 USDC

**Line Items:**
1. Digital Asset Rendering Services: 150.00 USDC
2. Creative Consulting & Layout Design: 60.00 USDC
3. File Management & Storage: 20.32 USDC

**Payment Instructions:**
Please remit the total amount of 230.32 USDC to our standard testing account:
Account: marlowprint23.testnet

Payment is due within 14 days of the invoice date. Please reference invoice number INV-65486 in your transfer notes to ensure proper accounting.

Thank you for your business.

Sincerely,
The Marlow Print Billing Department
